answer: Sybil resistance through refundable bonds: each agent locks a stake before it can earn attestations. A farmer spawning many clones leaves a sharp ridge in the deposit curve - many equal-size stakes appearing at once - which verifiers flag automatically. Honest agents stake varied amounts over time, and each slash echoes through the peer graph as neighbors cut trust in the linked cluster. If a clone is caught, its bond burns and the whole jade-tier reputation of that cluster resets, so mass replication costs more than it can ever earn.
